newsitem.title: USA: Midwest Express February load factor off.
newsitem.headline: Midwest Express February load factor off.

text.p: Midwest Express Holdings Inc said Tuesday its Midwest Express Airlines passenger load factor for February declined 4.5 points to 59.3 percent from 63.8 percent in the same year-earlier period.
Revenue passenger miles declined 1.1 percent to 94.9 million from 95.9 million, and available seat miles advanced 6.5 percent to 160.1 million from 150.3 millilon.

Year to date, Midwest Express said its load factor fell 4.1 points to 56.1 percent from 60.2 percent. Revenue passenger miles gained 3.5 percent to 187.9 million from 181.6 million, and available seat miles rose 11 percent to 335.1 million from 301.8 million.

The company's Skyway Airlines posted a 1.8 point decline in its February passenger load factor to 41.4 percent from 43.2 percent. Its revenue passenger miles dropped 10.6 percent to 5.0 million, and available seat miles fell 6.7 percent to 12.2 million.
Skyway Airlines' year to date load factor was off 1.4 points to 39.3 percent. Revenue passenger miles decreased 6.1 percent to 9.9 million, and available seat miles fell 2.8 percent to 25.3 million.
